appDesc.message: Switch this device between Keenetic router access policies in one click.

errNoChallenge.message: The router did not send an authentication challenge

errNoChallengeDetail.message: This address appears to serve something other than the KeeneticOS web interface.

errPasswordNotSet.message: The router password is not set

errSessionNotStored.message: The router accepted the password, but the session was not stored

errSessionNotStoredDetail.message: The browser is not sending the router's session cookie. Check that permission for the router address is granted in the extension settings.

errAuthRejected.message: The router rejected the username and password

errAuthRejectedDetail.message: If the credentials are definitely correct, close the router web interface tab: it refreshes the session and stops the extension from signing in.

errForbiddenDetail.message: KeeneticOS only accepts requests to /rci/ that carry its own Origin. The extension rewrites the header with a declarativeNetRequest rule — check that permission for the router address is granted in chrome://extensions and reload the extension.

errRciHttp.message: Request to the router failed: HTTP $status$

errBadResponse.message: Unexpected response format from the router

errWhoamiFailed.message: The router could not identify this device

errNoDeviceSelected.message: No device is selected in the settings

errPolicyNotApplied.message: The router did not apply the new policy

errPolicyNotAppliedDetail.message: Expected "$expected$", but after the write the router reports "$actual$".

errOriginRule.message: Could not install the Origin rewrite rule: $reason$

errNoBackgroundResponse.message: The extension background script did not respond

errBaseUrlNotSet.message: The router address is not set

errNoPermission.message: No access to the router address

errNoPermissionDetail.message: Open the extension settings and grant permission for $url$.
